secondaryValue: Stretched,Icons only,Five per row,Unfold on hover
fieldDescription: How the submarket buttons above the cargo and fleet screens are laid out. Stretched: the vanilla number of buttons per row widened to fill the row. Icons only: icon sized buttons without names (they still show in the tooltip) spaced evenly with as many per row as fit. Five per row (default): five buttons with names in each row; names too long for the button are cut short. Unfold on hover: icon sized buttons with one button opened to show its name; the button under the cursor opens and the open one folds while the row keeps its width. The last hovered button stays open after the cursor leaves. The storage button always sits at the right end of the last row. Changes apply the next time the screen opens.
How many seconds Unfold on hover takes to open a button fully (default 0.1). 0 opens it at once. Changes apply the next time the screen opens.
